Learning Resources

Open Dental is easy to use, but we always recommend utilizing all of our available tools to get the most out of your software experience. Our learning resources cover every skill level, save you time, and ensure proper software usage to reduce mistakes.

![](https://www.opendental.com/site/images/learningSitePageHeader.png)

## Webinars

Open Dental has a library of pre-recorded webinars available on our [YouTube Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@OpenDentalSoftware).

See [Webinars](https://www.opendental.com/site/webinars.html) for a list of suggested topics.

We have published a variety of videos ranging from basic to advanced topics.

## Help Feature

The [Help Feature](https://www.opendental.com/site/helpfeature.html) is accessible right from the Open Dental program by clicking the **?** icon in any window. Clicking the icon will launch the applicable help page for in-depth information on the feature. You can also easily search for other content or use the Table of Contents to navigate to other pages.

For new users, a good place to start is with the following pages:

- [Using Open Dental with a Converted Database](https://www.opendental.com/site/usingodconversion.html)
- [Using Open Dental with a Blank Database](https://www.opendental.com/site/usingodblank.html)

## Online and On-Site Trainings

Open Dental offers both online and on-site trainings with a live trainer from the Open Dental Support Team.

Detailed information is available here: [Training Resources](https://www.opendental.com/site/training.html)

Training rates are published here: [Fees for Software, Support, Services](https://opendental.com/site/fees.html#training)

## Online Communities and Resources

The following are helpful community resources you can use for open discussion with other Open Dental users as well as feedback from Open Dental employees.

- [Open Dental Blog](https://opendental.blog/)
  - Tips and tricks.
  - Guest posts.
  - Company updates.
- [Newsletter](https://us12.campaign-archive.com/home/?u=9e82b541f6452529f207517cc&id=4ba6c74a93)
  - Tips and tricks.
  - New feature highlights.
  - Community happenings.
  - Internal progress.
- [User Forum](http://opendentalsoft.com/forum/)
  - Advanced topics for technical users.
  - Community of other Open Dental Software users.
  - Questions and answers.
- Facebook
  - [User Group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/OpenDentalUsers/) provides peer to peer discussion with thousands of Open Dental users.
  - [Open Dental's company page](https://www.facebook.com/OpenDental/) provides updates, company events, and announcements.
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC2f1mkxYSud-V72gxpgmRrQ)
  - Watch helpful videos that include webinars, introduction to Open Dental, and new version overviews.
